style: Authentic live-action 35mm film still, cinematic evening interior, warm tungsten practical light mixed with cool blue window light, realistic skin texture with pores, gentle film grain, modest everyday clothing.

frames.name: tp_a
frames.prompt: Early December evening inside a small independent women's clothing boutique, closed for the day: a wooden clothing rail with a few winter pieces, a round mirror, a little paper-garland and fairy lights in the shop window, a cash counter with tissue paper and a shopping bag. The shop owner, a woman about 34 (Black American, short natural curls, small gold studs, a mustard-yellow cardigan over a black tee, a tape measure around her neck), stands center-left facing the camera at waist-up medium shot, holding up on a wooden hanger in her right hand the attached dress (exact same emerald-green crushed-velvet long-sleeve wrap midi dress with a self-tie sash), looking at it with a determined, thinking expression, her phone in her left hand. On the wall behind her, slightly out of focus, a paper wall calendar showing December with several days circled in red marker (no readable words). Camera at standing eye level.

frames.name: tp_b
frames.prompt: Top-down overhead shot (camera looking straight down) of a large wooden boutique cutting table at night under a warm lamp. On a plain warm-white cotton sheet in the center, the attached dress (exact same emerald-green crushed-velvet long-sleeve wrap midi dress with a self-tie sash) is laid perfectly flat and symmetrical. From the bottom edge, a woman's two hands (deep brown skin, mustard-yellow cardigan sleeves, a thin gold ring) hold a smartphone flat above the dress, taking a photo of it (we see the back of the phone, no logo). A pair of fabric scissors, a spool of gold ribbon and folded tissue paper lie at the edges of the table.
